three_layer_perovskite_N15.note: NOT a physical solar cell (n-p-n with electron-selective contacts, no hole path). See perovskite_3layer_audit.json. Efficiency 1.7% is a numerical trace (Voc=nan, Jsc~0). Reproduces ONLY with default raw spectrum (899.9 W/m²); diverges with spectrum(normalize=True) — see perovskite_repro_check.json.

or_reproduce.reason: Device is a singular-matrix stress test, not a PV simulation. The archived 'converges to 1e-8' outcome is non-physical (Voc=nan, Jsc=0). The record is pinned to the default-spectrum call path that produces it; the normalized-spectrum path is documented as a known divergence. Do not cite this as a device-performance number.
or_reproduce.positive_control: Perovskite p-i-n (Eg=1.55, non-selective ohmic contacts, N=120) converges to 4.4e-16, Voc=0.964 V, Jsc=11.9 mA/cm², PCE=7.96% — see validation/test_perovskite_pin.py and perovskite_p-i-n_audit.json.
